paragraphs: Cloudpermit sells online public works and community development software meant to help local governments modernize. The promise is a system that is easier for staff and better for residents.

Building permit applications come in online and permits can be issued as soon as payment is processed. Land use review covers rezonings, variances, subdivisions, site plans and public hearings. Code compliance ties complaint management, inspections and case tracking together. On the licensing side staff issue, revoke and renew licenses. The same pages cover short-term rental compliance. Inspections run in an app that works whether the inspector is online or offline. Interactive maps tie into a jurisdiction's own GIS.

Staff and residents can work in English, Spanish and French. Cloudpermit says the software is built in collaboration with local authorities and evolves alongside the governments it serves. It claims permits and licenses are issued 80% faster than on paper. An AI assistant called NoVa is offered inside the citizen portal.

quote.text: Cloudpermit, built in collaboration with local authorities, evolves alongside the governments we serve.
